# otelinji

> OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation CLI tool for Go. It rewrites Go source
> files, injecting a tracing block (span start + deferred error-recording
> span end) at the beginning of every exported function. Injection is
> template-driven, so custom templates allow OpenTracing or any other
> boilerplate insert at the start of functions.

Module: `github.com/hedhyw/otelinji` (Go). Install:
`go install github.com/hedhyw/otelinji/cmd/otelinji@latest`, Homebrew
(`brew install hedhyw/main/otelinji`), or the `hedhyw/otelinji` Docker image.

Key facts:
- CLI: `otelinji -filename file.go` prints the instrumented file;
  `-w` rewrites in place; `-template path` overrides the default embedded
  template; `-skip-generated` (default true) skips `DO NOT EDIT` files.
- Public helper package `github.com/hedhyw/otelinji/pkg/otelinji` provides
  `EndSpanWithErr(span, err, ...)`, which the injected code calls.
- Functions with a named `err` result get the error recorded in the span;
  differently named `ctx` parameters are detected.
- Already-instrumented functions are detected via template
  `//otelinji:check-indents` markers and skipped.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/hedhyw/otelinji/blob/main/README.md): installation, basic and recursive usage, Docker examples, CLI help
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/hedhyw/otelinji/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guide for coding agents — CLI/API summary, repo layout, template rules, commands
- [API reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hedhyw/otelinji/pkg/otelinji): godoc for the public helper package
- [Default template](https://github.com/hedhyw/otelinji/blob/main/internal/pkg/assets/otel.tmpl): the injected tracing block and available template arguments
